summary: BASELINE ESTABLISHED for G2/G3. Ungrounded GR00T N1.6 (K=1, no selection, no overlay) on RoboCasa PnPCounterToSink, scenes pinned: 8/15 = 53.3% in BOTH independent runs, Wilson 95% CI [30.1%, 75.2%]. The interval contains NVIDIA's published 46.0% zero-shot figure, so the serving and observation pipeline reproduces the published behaviour and the harness can be trusted for comparisons. The CI is wide at n=15: a grounded arm would need roughly a 25-30 point improvement to clear it at this sample size, so any future comparison should either raise n substantially or use a paired per-scene test rather than comparing marginal rates.
